items.lede: A cyberattack has hit supermarkets in Europe, disabling refrigerators.
items.title: 'Unprecedented' Cyberattack cripples supermarket fridges across Europe as hackers activate automatic defrosting

items.lede: Attackers remotely defrosted refrigerators at multiple French supermarket chains overnight in a cyberattack that reportedly targeted Danfoss refrigeration controllers. [...]
items.title: Cyberattack shuts down refrigerators at French supermarkets
